description: Not for a file attached in this chat: that goes to visarun_upload_document's file. An address to put one file's bytes into Visarun storage with an HTTP PUT, for a file over 3 MB or one on disk: run curl -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: <its type>' --data-binary @<file> '<upload_url>' where you have a terminal, then call visarun_upload_document with the staged_path. It lasts two hours and takes one file. Without a terminal (a chat), you cannot send the file: create a one-time upload page with visarun_create_upload_page.
name: visarun_create_upload_link
title: Create an upload link
